findings.title: Multi-factor authentication not enabled for privileged users
findings.description: Global administrators and subscription owners should have MFA enabled
findings.recommendation: Enable MFA for all privileged accounts in Azure AD

findings.title: Storage account public access not restricted
findings.description: Storage accounts allow public blob access which poses security risks
findings.recommendation: Disable public blob access on storage accounts

findings.title: Key Vault access policies too permissive
findings.description: Key Vault has overly broad access policies assigned
findings.recommendation: Review and restrict Key Vault access policies

findings.title: SQL Database auditing not enabled
findings.description: SQL Database auditing is not configured for compliance monitoring
findings.recommendation: Enable SQL Database auditing and log analytics

findings.title: Network security groups allow unrestricted access
findings.description: NSG rules allow traffic from any source (0.0.0.0/0)
findings.recommendation: Restrict NSG rules to specific IP ranges

findings.title: Virtual machines lack endpoint protection
findings.description: VMs do not have antimalware or endpoint protection installed
findings.recommendation: Install and configure endpoint protection on all VMs

findings.title: Security Center standard tier not enabled
findings.description: Azure Security Center is not configured with standard tier
findings.recommendation: Enable Security Center standard tier for enhanced protection

findings.title: Log Analytics workspace not configured
findings.description: Centralized logging is not properly configured
findings.recommendation: Configure Log Analytics workspace for centralized logging

findings.title: Application Gateway WAF not enabled
findings.description: Web Application Firewall is not enabled on Application Gateway
findings.recommendation: Enable WAF on Application Gateway with OWASP rules

findings.title: Backup not configured for critical resources
findings.description: Azure Backup is not configured for VMs and databases
findings.recommendation: Configure Azure Backup for all critical resources

findings.title: Resource locks not applied
findings.description: Critical resources lack resource locks to prevent accidental deletion
findings.recommendation: Apply resource locks to critical infrastructure

findings.title: Disk encryption not enabled
findings.description: VM disks are not encrypted with Azure Disk Encryption
findings.recommendation: Enable Azure Disk Encryption for all VM disks

findings.title: Network Watcher not enabled
findings.description: Network monitoring and diagnostics are not properly configured
findings.recommendation: Enable Network Watcher for network monitoring

findings.title: Azure AD Privileged Identity Management not configured
findings.description: PIM is not configured for privileged role management
findings.recommendation: Configure Azure AD PIM for privileged access management

findings.title: Activity log retention not configured
findings.description: Activity logs are not retained for the required compliance period
findings.recommendation: Configure activity log retention for 90+ days

findings.title: Azure Policy not implemented
findings.description: Governance policies are not enforced through Azure Policy
findings.recommendation: Implement Azure Policy for governance and compliance

findings.title: Resource tags not standardized
findings.description: Resources lack consistent tagging for cost management and governance
findings.recommendation: Implement standardized resource tagging strategy

findings.title: Cost management alerts not configured
findings.description: Budget alerts and cost management are not properly configured
findings.recommendation: Configure budget alerts and cost management policies

findings.title: Service Health alerts not configured
findings.description: Service health notifications are not configured for critical services
findings.recommendation: Configure Service Health alerts for proactive monitoring

findings.title: Azure Advisor recommendations not reviewed
findings.description: Azure Advisor recommendations have not been reviewed or implemented
findings.recommendation: Regularly review and implement Azure Advisor recommendations

findings.title: Resource naming conventions not followed
findings.description: Resources do not follow organizational naming conventions
findings.recommendation: Implement and enforce resource naming conventions

findings.title: Update management not configured
findings.description: Automated update management is not configured for VMs
findings.recommendation: Configure Azure Update Management for automated patching

findings.title: Azure Security Benchmark not applied
findings.description: Azure Security Benchmark policies are not applied to the subscription
findings.recommendation: Apply Azure Security Benchmark initiative

findings.title: Diagnostic settings not configured
findings.description: Diagnostic settings are not configured for all Azure services
findings.recommendation: Configure diagnostic settings for all Azure services
